"""Ticket 10: number-token extraction.

Mask-then-extract, strict by default: when in doubt the gate rejects. The
gate now checks that claim prose names the metric it cites (label, and
period word for period metrics) and that direction words agree with the
cited values.

What is still not caught, all of it: a claim can name the right metric,
period and direction and still say something false in its other words,
including comparison words outside the pinned lists (``climbed``,
``declined``, ``below``, ``above``); in a multi ref claim the values are
not bound to their order in the sentence; a claim with only ``fact_ids``
has no metric binding, so its direction words are not checked; ``eight
and a half hours`` backs as 8; ``twenty-one`` backs as 20 whatever
follows, because a ``one`` joined to the word before it is not a token;
two metrics that share a label can swap,
since a feed source and the feed total both read as ``feed``; a digit or
number word inside a category or tag name, such as ``3D``, reads as a
number and is rejected unless a ref backs it. Backing still compares
absolute values. Direction is checked separately by the binding rule, not
by backing.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import re
from collections.abc import Collection
from dataclasses import dataclass
from decimal import Decimal

# Month names match only when capitalized, so "may 9" is not a date.
_MONTHS = (
    r"Jan(?:uary)?|Feb(?:ruary)?|Mar(?:ch)?|Apr(?:il)?|May|Jun(?:e)?|"
    r"Jul(?:y)?|Aug(?:ust)?|Sep(?:t(?:ember)?)?|Oct(?:ober)?|"
    r"Nov(?:ember)?|Dec(?:ember)?"
)
_YEAR = r"(?:19\d{2}|20\d{2})"

# A date or clock time directly followed by a measure word (singular or
# plural) or a plural count word is a quantity, not a time: a quantity
# above one takes the plural, so "the 14:00 call" stays a time while
# "10:30 calls" is a number. Lookaheads are case-insensitive.
_UNMASK_MEASURE = (
    r"hour|hours|hr|hrs|h|minute|minutes|min|mins|"
    r"step|steps|day|days|percent|times"
)
_UNMASK_PLURAL_COUNT = r"pushes|commits|events|blocks|tasks|items|calls|cards|prs"
_UNMASK = rf"(?:{_UNMASK_MEASURE}|{_UNMASK_PLURAL_COUNT})"

_ISO_DATE_RE = re.compile(rf"\b\d{{4}}-\d{{2}}-\d{{2}}\b(?!\s*(?i:{_UNMASK})\b)")
_DAY_FIRST_RE = re.compile(rf"\b\d{{1,2}}/\d{{1,2}}/\d{{2,4}}\b(?!\s*(?i:{_UNMASK})\b)")
_MONTH_DATE_RE = re.compile(
    rf"(?:\b\d{{1,2}}\s+(?:{_MONTHS})\b(?:\s*,?\s*{_YEAR})?"
    rf"|\b(?:{_MONTHS})\s+\d{{1,2}}\b(?:\s*,?\s*{_YEAR})?"
    rf"|\b(?:{_MONTHS})\s+{_YEAR}\b)(?!\s*(?i:{_UNMASK})\b)"
)
# A clock time followed by a measure or plural count word is a quantity.
_TIME_RE = re.compile(
    rf"\b\d{{1,2}}:\d{{2}}(?::\d{{2}})?\s*(?:am|pm)?(?!\s*(?i:{_UNMASK})\b)",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)
_REF_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*:[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+")
_IDENT_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_-]*\d[A-Za-z0-9_-]*")
_ORDINAL_RE = re.compile(r"\b\d+(?:st|nd|rd|th)\b", re.IGNORECASE)
_NUMBER_RE = re.compile(r"-?(?:\d{1,3}(?:,\d{3})+|\d+)(?:\.\d+)?%?")

_NUMBER_WORDS: dict[str, int] = {
    "zero": 0,
    "one": 1,
    "two": 2,
    "three": 3,
    "four": 4,
    "five": 5,
    "six": 6,
    "seven": 7,
    "eight": 8,
    "nine": 9,
    "ten": 10,
    "eleven": 11,
    "twelve": 12,
    "thirteen": 13,
    "fourteen": 14,
    "fifteen": 15,
    "sixteen": 16,
    "seventeen": 17,
    "eighteen": 18,
    "nineteen": 19,
    "twenty": 20,
    "thirty": 30,
    "forty": 40,
    "fifty": 50,
    "sixty": 60,
    "seventy": 70,
    "eighty": 80,
    "ninety": 90,
    "hundred": 100,
    "thousand": 1000,
    "million": 1000000,
    "dozen": 12,
}
# Every spelled-out number except "one" is a token whatever word follows.
_UNCONDITIONAL_WORDS = tuple(word for word in _NUMBER_WORDS if word != "one")
# "one" stays a token only before a unit or count word, or joined by a
# hyphen to a word on that same list ("one-hour", "one-day"): "one-off"
# and "one-on-one" are normal words and stay free.
_ONE_LOOKAHEAD = (
    r"hour|hours|hr|hrs|h|minute|minutes|min|mins|"
    r"step|steps|day|days|percent|"
    r"push|pushes|commit|commits|event|events|block|blocks|"
    r"task|tasks|item|items|call|calls|card|cards|pr|prs|times"
)
_WORD_NUMBER_RE = re.compile(
    r"\b(" + "|".join(sorted(_UNCONDITIONAL_WORDS, key=len, reverse=True)) + r")\b",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)
_ONE_NUMBER_RE = re.compile(
    r"(?<!-)\b(one)(?=\s+(?:" + _ONE_LOOKAHEAD + r")\b|-(?:" + _ONE_LOOKAHEAD + r")\b)",
    re.IGNORECASE,
)


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class NumberToken:
    """One measured quantity: raw text, value, offset, and decimal places."""

    raw: str
    value: Decimal
    start: int
    places: int


def _mask(text: str, pattern: re.Pattern[str]) -> str:
    return pattern.sub(lambda match: " " * len(match.group(0)), text)


def _mask_known(text: str, pattern: re.Pattern[str], known_ids: Collection[str]) -> str:
    """Blank only matches that exactly equal a cited fact/metric ID."""

    def repl(match: re.Match[str]) -> str:
        if match.group(0) in known_ids:
            return " " * len(match.group(0))
        return match.group(0)

    return pattern.sub(repl, text)


def extract_number_tokens(
    text: str, known_ids: Collection[str] = ()
) -> tuple[NumberToken, ...]:
    """Extract quantity tokens left to right after masking non-quantities.

    ``known_ids`` holds the fact/metric IDs cited on the claim being
    scanned: an identifier or colon reference is masked only when it
    exactly equals one of them.
    """
    masked = _mask(text, _ISO_DATE_RE)
    masked = _mask(masked, _DAY_FIRST_RE)
    masked = _mask(masked, _MONTH_DATE_RE)
    masked = _mask(masked, _TIME_RE)
    masked = _mask_known(masked, _REF_RE, known_ids)
    masked = _mask_known(masked, _IDENT_RE, known_ids)
    masked = _mask(masked, _ORDINAL_RE)
    tokens: list[NumberToken] = []
    for match in _NUMBER_RE.finditer(masked):
        raw = match.group(0)
        start = match.start()
        if raw.startswith("-"):
            prev = masked[start - 1] if start > 0 else ""
            if prev.isalpha() or prev.isdigit():
                raw = raw[1:]
                start += 1
        core = raw.removesuffix("%")
        core = core.replace(",", "")
        dot = core.find(".")
        places = len(core) - dot - 1 if dot >= 0 else 0
        tokens.append(
            NumberToken(raw=raw, value=Decimal(core), start=start, places=places)
        )
    for pattern in (_WORD_NUMBER_RE, _ONE_NUMBER_RE):
        for match in pattern.finditer(masked):
            word = match.group(1)
            tokens.append(
                NumberToken(
                    raw=word,
                    value=Decimal(_NUMBER_WORDS[word.casefold()]),
                    start=match.start(1),
                    places=0,
                )
            )
    tokens.sort(key=lambda token: token.start)
    return tuple(tokens)

"""Ticket 8: briefing document schemas (the gated artifact).

A briefing is one typed document per objective profile. ``Claim.id`` is an
addition to the brief's field list: L0 requires unique IDs and violations
need stable locations, so every claim carries one.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import math
import re
from typing import Annotated, Literal

from pydantic import AwareDatetime, Field, field_validator, model_validator

from framework.schemas.base import Dimension, SchemaModel
from framework.schemas.events import NonEmptyStr

SectionType = Literal[
    "overall_state", "since_last", "working", "not_working", "actions"
]

ActionKind = Literal[
    "build",
    "write",
    "read",
    "apply",
    "outreach",
    "walk",
    "rest",
    "music",
    "social",
    "plan",
    "checkin",
]

EvidenceKind = Literal["tap", "calendar_tag", "github_push", "no_screen"]

COMMITMENT_TAG_PATTERN = r"iki-[a-z]+"
_COMMITMENT_TAG_RE = re.compile(COMMITMENT_TAG_PATTERN)


class MetricRef(SchemaModel):
    """A numeric value cited by a claim, reconciled against a snapshot."""

    metric_id: NonEmptyStr
    value: float

    @field_validator("value")
    @classmethod
    def _finite_value(cls, value: float) -> float:
        if not math.isfinite(value):
            raise ValueError("metric value must be finite")
        return value


class Claim(SchemaModel):
    """One prose statement plus its evidence (facts and/or metric refs)."""

    id: NonEmptyStr
    text: NonEmptyStr
    fact_ids: Annotated[list[NonEmptyStr], Field(default_factory=list)]
    metric_refs: Annotated[list[MetricRef], Field(default_factory=list)]


class Commitment(SchemaModel):
    """One user-written commitment an action may be scheduled from."""

    id: NonEmptyStr
    profile_id: NonEmptyStr
    title: NonEmptyStr
    kind: ActionKind
    dimension: Dimension
    evidence: EvidenceKind
    tag: NonEmptyStr | None = None

    @field_validator("title")
    @classmethod
    def _non_blank_title(cls, title: str) -> str:
        if not title.strip():
            raise ValueError("commitment title must not be blank")
        return title

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _tag_exactly_for_calendar_tag(self) -> Commitment:
        if self.evidence == "calendar_tag":
            if self.tag is None:
                raise ValueError("calendar_tag commitments require a tag")
            if _COMMITMENT_TAG_RE.fullmatch(self.tag) is None:
                raise ValueError("commitment tag must fullmatch iki-[a-z]+")
        elif self.tag is not None:
            raise ValueError("only calendar_tag commitments carry a tag")
        return self


class Action(SchemaModel):
    """One proposed item in the ``actions`` section."""

    id: NonEmptyStr
    commitment_id: NonEmptyStr
    kind: ActionKind
    text: NonEmptyStr
    dimension: Dimension
    proposed_start: AwareDatetime
    proposed_end: AwareDatetime

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _end_after_start(self) -> Action:
        if self.proposed_end <= self.proposed_start:
            raise ValueError("proposed_end must be after proposed_start")
        return self


class Section(SchemaModel):
    """One typed section; its ``type`` is its identity (no ``id`` field)."""

    type: SectionType
    claims: Annotated[list[Claim], Field(default_factory=list)]
    actions: Annotated[list[Action], Field(default_factory=list)]


class Briefing(SchemaModel):
    """One gated briefing for one profile at one slot."""

    id: NonEmptyStr
    profile_id: NonEmptyStr
    subject_id: NonEmptyStr
    slot: AwareDatetime
    parent_briefing_id: NonEmptyStr | None = None
    sections: Annotated[list[Section], Field(default_factory=list)]

"""Fact, Profile and Criterion schemas."""

import math
from typing import Annotated

from pydantic import AwareDatetime, Field, model_validator

from framework.schemas.base import Dimension, SchemaModel, Tier
from framework.schemas.events import NonEmptyStr


class FactWindow(SchemaModel):
    start: AwareDatetime
    end: AwareDatetime

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _end_not_before_start(self) -> "FactWindow":
        if self.end < self.start:
            raise ValueError("fact window end must not be before start")
        return self


class Fact(SchemaModel):
    id: NonEmptyStr
    subject_id: NonEmptyStr
    window: FactWindow
    statement: NonEmptyStr
    evidence: Annotated[list[NonEmptyStr], Field(min_length=1)]
    tier: Tier


class IkigaiWeights(SchemaModel):
    love: Annotated[float, Field(ge=0, le=1)]
    good_at: Annotated[float, Field(ge=0, le=1)]
    world_needs: Annotated[float, Field(ge=0, le=1)]
    paid_for: Annotated[float, Field(ge=0, le=1)]

    @model_validator(mode="after")
    def _sums_to_one(self) -> "IkigaiWeights":
        total = self.love + self.good_at + self.world_needs + self.paid_for
        if not math.isclose(total, 1.0, rel_tol=0.0, abs_tol=1e-6):
            raise ValueError("ikigai weights must sum to 1.0")
        return self


class Profile(SchemaModel):
    subject_id: NonEmptyStr
    profile_id: NonEmptyStr
    label: str
    version: Annotated[int, Field(ge=1)]
    weights: IkigaiWeights


class Criterion(SchemaModel):
    id: NonEmptyStr
    profile_id: NonEmptyStr
    dimension: Dimension
    text: NonEmptyStr
    hidden: bool
    version: Annotated[int, Field(ge=1)]
